name: Cannonball ~Neko Neko Machine Mou Race!~
original_name: CANNONBALL ～ねこねこマシン猛レース！～
source:
There is a big race event in space called Cannonball!

People living in the harsh space environment enter this huge interstellar event with big dreams and excitement in their hearts. The winner gets a huge reward, or at least that's what has been promised... 

Fifteen riders are qualified to enter this race that will take on various courses...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=17403]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
宇宙中有一项名为Cannonball的盛大竞速赛事！

生活在严酷太空环境中的人们怀着远大梦想与满腔热情，投身这场规模宏大的星际赛事。获胜者将得到巨额奖金——至少主办方是如此承诺的……

共有十五名车手取得参赛资格，他们将在风格各异的赛道上一决高下……

[翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=17403]Getchu[/url]]
